ideas.pitch: A predictive traffic congestion model specifically built for Atlanta intersections using historical MARTA and GDOT data, featuring calibrated prediction intervals to help commuters avoid gridlock.
ideas.title: Atlanta Traffic Flow Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: It follows the exact winning pattern of AI-incident-forecasting by utilizing rigorous statistical forecasting rather than a generic wrapper, which appeals to technical judges looking for genuine ML depth.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered coordination app that groups elderly residents in Atlanta neighborhoods for group walks along the BeltLine, matching them with local student volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: BeltLine Senior Socializer
ideas.why_it_could_win: It mirrors the grand prize winner Outreach by targeting clear, measurable social impact tailored directly to the local Atlanta community, a favorite for judges seeking real-world value.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition assistant that pulls real-time daily menus from Georgia Tech dining halls to build personalized, macro-optimized meal plans for student athletes and busy majors.
ideas.title: Campus Dining Nutrition Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets a problem every student and judge in the room feels directly on a daily basis—campus dining choices—following the winning pattern of solving familiar pain points.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent platform that lets local Atlanta small businesses automatically settle invoices and procure supplies using USDC micro-transactions.
ideas.title: Midtown Merchant Autonomous Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: It implements the proven winning formula of combining autonomous AI agents with crypto escrow rails, demonstrating immediate economic utility for local commerce.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite and aerial monitoring tool that tracks land use and environmental compliance for industrial zones around the Atlanta metro area.
ideas.title: Atlanta Industrial Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages geospatial data visualization and computer vision to solve enterprise-grade monitoring challenges, matching the technical ambition of the GeoNex-ATLAS runner-up.
